summary: Python CLI reads authority-manifest.v1.json from resolved plan dir; required args: --repository-root, --plan-dir, --out; processes authority_sources as authority_source and candidate_inputs as implementation_input; validates nonempty string paths and existing files; normalizes separators; hashes file bytes with sha256: prefix; canonical JSON uses UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, trailing newline; emits schema_version skill-input-plan-receipt.v2; target is plan path relative to root; records selection and selection/content hashes plus sources; authorizes=[]; scope=plan-ready-only; creates output parent and writes canonical payload; prints pass JSON with output path and empty authorizations; raises ValueError on invalid/missing declarations; exits 0 on success
